en: Persistent import sessions and visual mapping
zh: 持久化导入会话与可视化映射
summaryEn: Parse each CSV/Excel file once in a persistent Worker, inspect worksheets and bounded previews, map unfamiliar headers, batch-repair source cells, generate reports on demand and collect full accepted rows only at delivery. React and Vue workbench examples cover the complete flow.
summaryZh: 每个 CSV/Excel 文件仅在持久化 Worker 中解析一次，支持工作表与有限预览、陌生表头映射、来源单元格批量纠错、按需报告，并仅在交付时收集完整可提交行；React/Vue 工作台覆盖完整流程。

summaryEn: Dedicated repair and report workers with cancellation and deadlines. React/Vue examples generate reports only on download, cache unchanged reports and select source cells directly from issues. Worker payloads omit unrelated result arrays.
summaryZh: 新增可取消、可超时的纠错与报告 Worker。React/Vue 示例仅在下载时生成报告，复用未改变结果的报告缓存，点击问题即可定位来源单元格，跨线程不再传输任务无关的结果数组。

en: Repair imports and reduce preparation overhead
summaryEn: Repair source cells without reparsing files, with full validation and React/Vue editing examples. Indexed header matching, cached source locations and removal of unnecessary empty-rule passes reduce preparation overhead. See the benchmark guide for measurements and limits.
summaryZh: 新增来源单元格纠错接口和 React/Vue 页面内修改案例，无需重新解析文件，仍执行全量校验。通过表头索引、来源定位缓存和跳过空业务规则遍历降低开销，性能数据和范围见相关指南。

summaryEn: Dedicated worker imports with cancellation, deadlines and optional repair reports. Added React and Vue examples.
summaryZh: 独立线程导入支持取消、超时和纠错报告，新增 React/Vue 接入示例。

summaryEn: Portable import templates, dictionary cleaning and batch validation. Pages content deployment no longer waits for HTTPS certificate issuance.
summaryZh: 新增可复用导入模板、字典清洗和批量校验。Pages 内容部署不再等待 HTTPS 证书签发。

summaryEn: Validated file-import workflows and complete API examples.
summaryZh: 新增带校验的文件导入流程及完整 API 使用案例。

summaryEn: Streaming workbook operations, formula calculation and template editing.
summaryZh: 新增工作簿流式处理、公式计算和模板编辑。

summaryEn: Cancellable comparison and explicit Excel import policies.
summaryZh: 新增可取消比较和明确的 Excel 导入策略。

zh: 模块化 Excel/CSV 工具集
summaryEn: Modular Excel and CSV data APIs. Documentation language and theme controls moved to the top navigation.
summaryZh: 新增模块化 Excel/CSV 数据接口，文档语言和主题切换移至顶部导航。

summaryEn: Linked the npm package to the bilingual documentation site.
summaryZh: 为 npm 包补充中英文文档站链接。

summaryEn: Build distribution files before packing the npm package.
summaryZh: 修复 npm 打包前未构建分发文件的问题。

summaryEn: Key-based table comparison, column mappings, composite keys, validation errors and CSV export.
summaryZh: 首次提供按键比较表格、列映射、复合键、校验错误和 CSV 导出。
